subject: DPA pathway decision, SCC module selection & intake for FinRoll
messages:
From: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@finroll.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finroll.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T15:12:00Z
Subject: Thanks for the demo — DPA/SOC2/SCC next steps

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — FinRoll's product team liked the low latency routing and the dedicated capacity options. A quick follow-up on compliance so we can loop Legal and Procurement:

- Can you confirm Redwood's SOC 2 status and whether a copy of the report/attestation is available for review?
- For GDPR, we need to understand the DPA pathway you prefer (processor-by-default vs. controller scenarios) and which SCC module you'd propose for an EU transfer.
- We'll need a vendor security questionnaire (I can send ours) — can your team start the intake so we can map to your controls?

Procurement is copied; goal is to have an initial contracting path scoped by next week.

Appreciate any docs you can share.

Best,
Emma Sullivan
Head of Security & Privacy
FinRoll Inc.
[Attachment: finroll_vendor_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (Excel, 120 KB)]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@finroll.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@finroll.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T09:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — DPA/SOC2/SCC next steps

Hi Emma — great to meet you and the FinRoll team. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the compliance items you flagged: 

1) SOC 2
- Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II (security & availability) for our hosted and dedicated services. I can share a redacted report and our SOC 2 summary.
- Action: I attached the request pack and will send the redacted report under NDA if needed.

2) DPA / Controller vs Processor
- Standard posture: Redwood acts as a processor when customers send us personal data through our inference API. We support controller-determined roles where a customer explicitly directs processing that would affect legal responsibility (rare).
- Recommendation: For FinRoll's use case (inference on customer PII for product features), we should proceed with a Processor DPA; we will include language that allows for configurable controller-side options if you need them.

3) SCC module selection
- For EU transfers, we propose using the Processor-to-Controller (P2C) SCC module for clarity when a customer retains control over lawfulness of processing; alternatively, we can adopt the Processor-to-Processor (P2P) variant if you prefer retained obligations on both sides.
- Monica will follow up with the legal wording we typically include in the DPA.

4) Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ)
- Thanks for the questionnaire; Monica's team will take point on the intake and return a filled version. If there are technical artifacts you want (network diagrams, data flow), please flag them.

Next steps (proposed):
- I attach our DPA template for your review (redwood_dpa_template_v1.pdf).
- Monica will complete the VSQ and return by EOD Tuesday (2026-10-12).
- Emma / Procurement to confirm whether FinRoll requires the full SOC 2 report or a summary + SOC attestation.

If that plan looks good I'll set a follow-up on Thursday to go through any redlines.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_dpa_template_v1.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@finroll.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@finroll.com>
Date: 2026-10-10T13:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — DPA/SOC2/SCC next steps

Emma / team — Monica here (security intake). A couple of clarifying points so we can return the VSQ accurately: 

- Data scope: please confirm whether FinRoll will send raw customer PII to Redwood for inference, or if you'll be sending tokenized/hashed identifiers. This affects retention and encryption controls we surface.
- Transfers & SCCs: to align with your legal team, can you indicate whether FinRoll's legal prefers the Processor-to-Controller or Processor-to-Processor SCC set? If undecided, we recommend P2C for the model-inference workflow because it more clearly reflects your decision-making authority over lawful basis.
- Retention: what's your expected retention window for inference logs/inputs (e.g., 0-7 days / 8-30 days / >30 days)? We can propose default retention in the DPA but are open to configuring per-deal.

Attachments: we've started the VSQ intake and attached our working copy for your reference (vendor_security_questionnaire_FINROLL.xlsx). We'll fill sections marked as "Redwood to complete" and return the completed file by Tuesday EOD.

Small ask: if Procurement can share any preferred DPA redlines upfront (clauses on indemnity/export controls/data subject rights), that helps speed review.

Thanks — I'll aim to get the filled VSQ back by 2026-10-12.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_security_questionnaire_FINROLL.xlsx (Excel, 95 KB)]

From: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@finroll.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finroll.com>, Oliver Reyes <oliver.reyes@finroll.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — DPA/SOC2/SCC next steps

David / Monica — thanks for the clear plan and for sending the templates. Quick replies inline: 

> Data scope: please confirm whether FinRoll will send raw customer PII

We will be sending unhashed customer email addresses and profile data tied to feature flags for inference. Retention target is 14 days for debug logs; derived features will be stored as non-identifiable aggregates.

> SCC preference

Legal is leaning toward Processor-to-Controller (P2C) SCCs — they want the ability to assert lawful basis. P2C sounds fine to us.

> SOC2

Procurement would like to receive the redacted SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA; please send over the redacted report and the summary. I'll loop in Procurement directly if you need a signed NDA.

Attached: our filled questionnaire (finroll_filled_vsq_v1.xlsx) — most fields completed, a few tech clarifications pending (network topology and logging retention).

Next asks:
- Can Redwood confirm a target date for a DPA countersign? We aim for signature the week of 2026-10-19 to align with our sprint planning.
- Monica: any specific evidence artifacts you plan to attach with the VSQ (e.g., encryption config, SOC attestation) so Procurement knows what's coming?

Thanks — will be available all week for a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Emma Sullivan
Head of Security & Privacy
FinRoll Inc.
[Attachment: finroll_filled_vsq_v1.xlsx (Excel, 32 KB)]
